title: On the Automorphism Groups of Berman Codes and associated Abelian Codes
summary: The automorphism group of a code is the group of permutations that map a code to itself. Berman codes are a class of binary linear codes characterized by two integer parameters $n\geq 2$ and $m\geq 1$, and this class includes the Reed-Muller codes as well. The class of Berman codes and their duals were recently shown to achieve the capacity of the binary erasure channel. A number of abelian codes that arise from the intersection and subspace sums of Berman and Dual Berman codes were also identified recently, for odd $n\geq 3$.
